messages:
sana: Quick sync 1: We need a concrete opt-in workflow for customers who want stable egress IPs. Sketching three modes: shared ephemeral allocator (default), provider-managed dedicated gateway (opt-in), and customer-managed gateway (opt-in advanced). Thoughts?

drew: Short take: keep default cheap & simple. Opt-in should be explicit in controlplane API + Console. Also add a billing tag so finance can bill gateway hours.

zoe: Agree. For provider-managed gateway we need lifecycle ops: create, upgrade, rotate certs, drain, delete. We should define minimal API surface: POST /gateways, GET /gateways/{id}, POST /gateways/{id}/drain.

sam: Two critical infra constraints: 1) cross-account peering lifecycle (we need infra automation to create peering and routes). 2) IP preservation SLA for provider-managed gateway. If peering flakes we must failover. Fallbacks?

sana: Fallbacks: (a) automatic fallback to ephemeral allocator (best-effort, increased latency), (b) route via regional managed-relay (higher latency, isolated), (c) customer alert + paused traffic. Prefer (a) + alert + automated circuit breaker.

drew: How does this affect controlplane separation for Private customers? If CP is separate tenant, peering must be initiated and accepted by customer account or we require an infra role on their side. That changes onboarding docs.

zoe: Two onboarding variants: 1) Provider-managed peering: customer grants us cross-account role to create peering and route entries. 2) Customer-provisioned peering: they run a guided workflow and provide peering id + route table ids back to us. The latter keeps cp separation but is more manual.

sana: UX idea: Console shows a short-lived presigned token + a CloudFormation snippet the customer runs. That creates VPC peering and registers peering-id with our controlplane. Minimizes long-lived credentials.

sam: Good. Security note: presigned token life should be < 1h and single-use. Also require verification of route table attachments. Store only the peering id and verify connectivity via active probe.

drew: Metrics needed: gateway.uptime_pct, gateway.alloc_ip_count, allocator.pool_free, allocator.lease_acquire_latency, failover.count, peering_handshake_time. Add traces that link a request id to gateway id (not secrets).

zoe: Telemetry schema (logs/events): all lease/gateway events must include: event_id, actor (controlplane|customer), gateway_id|lease_id, tenant_id, correlation_id. No token material.

sana: Ops playbook (brief): - Peering down: detect via health probes -> mark gateway unhealthy, trigger failover to allocator, page oncall, create incident with runbook link. - Pool depletion: throttle new long-lived egress sessions -> emit high severity alert, enable emergency IP expansion (provision extra ENIs) or advise customers.

sam: Implementation plan (spike -> beta -> GA): Spike: implement allocator with lease TTL and reconciliation + Console opt-in flow mock. Beta: provider-managed gateway with automated peering (small set of customers, manual acceptance). GA: self-service in Console + customer-managed gateway flow.

drew: One more engineering constraint: when a tenant opts into dedicated gateway, existing sockets might be mid-flight. We need a graceful cutover: new connections route via gateway; existing keep using old path until idle, with a configured drain window (default 10m). Documented in API as ?drain_timeout.

zoe: Also cert rotation: gateways should trust the CP via short-lived mTLS certs. Plan: issue per-gateway certs with 24h lifetime, rotate via controlplane CA and KMS. Include auto-rotate and manual-rotate endpoints.

sana: Security addendum: when customer-provisioned peering exists, validate that peering owner matches tenant_id and that routes only point to allowed subnets. Reject if route table contains unexpected entries.

deploy-bot: deploy:staging 1: provider-gateway-spike deployed to staging for 3 customers. Monitoring endpoints: /health/gateway, allocator metrics.

drew: Action items: 1) sana to write RFC describing opt-in modes, APIs, and runbooks. 2) zoe to draft Console UX flows and CloudFormation snippet. 3) sam to implement allocator metrics + lease reconciliation. 4) drew to own peering automation spike and safety checks. Reconvene next Tue.

sana: Will do. I'll include sequence diagrams and a sample presigned CF template in RFC. Thanks! :thumbsup:
